description: False safety comment + idempotency key is best-effort only. (1) bank-fanout.mjs:39 claims 'the adapter re-checks before any real send', but makeGmoAdapter (bank-payout-watcher.mjs:56-62) performs NO balance re-check before submit — the comment overstates the safety net. (2) The idempotency key is a 32-bit non-cryptographic hash (bank-payout-watcher.mjs:44-49: h = h*31 + charCode, masked to int32) — collision-prone across distinct batches, and is sent only as an x-idempotency-key HEADER (gmo-furikomi.mjs:50-52) whose server-side honoring by GMO Aozora is UNVERIFIED (the whole submit path is flagged UNVERIFIED, gmo-furikomi.mjs:5,45-47). So the FIND-B 'defense-in-depth' dedupe is unproven against the real provider and could in principle collide two different batches onto one key. (3) Minor: comment at bank-payout-watcher.mjs:107 says env 'GMO_JPY_POOL' but code reads 'GMO_JPY_POOL_DEV' (line 127).

evidence.snippet: for (i...) { h = (h * 31 + sig.charCodeAt(i)) | 0; } return `anicca-ubi-${(h >>> 0).toString(36)}`;  // 32-bit hash, header-only, GMO honoring UNVERIFIED
